evidence.reason: `uniform` only rejects `null`, so a one-element set `[undefined]` is accepted as uniform. The code maps `priceCoverage` and `priceTableRevision` directly from attempt leaves; if a priced leaf omits either field, the set becomes `[undefined]`, `coverageIncomplete` stays false, and the modeled USD aggregate is reported without the intended partial/unknown marking. The later metadata projection can also emit `undefined`, which JSON serialization drops. Changing the check to `values[0] != null` treats missing metadata the same as absent `null`, making the USD subtotal partial while preserving behavior for present, uniform metadata.
